task.description: Hard gate: review DDL-01/MIG-04/MIG-05/MIG-06 against docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md. This is a tenant-data-path change: three NEW admin HTTP routes (src/api/routes/platform_migrations.zig -- run/status/resume, cross-tenant blast radius) gated by Role.PLATFORM_ADMIN, and a new boot-time DB-touching gate (src/operations/pending_migration_gate.zig). Check: role-gate correctness on all 3 routes (403 for non-PLATFORM_ADMIN, verified not just present but actually checked BEFORE any DB write), SQL parameterization, no catch unreachable, and specifically whether the MIG-06 status endpoint could leak cross-tenant information to a caller who should not see other tenants' migration failure details (even though PLATFORM_ADMIN legitimately sees all tenants, confirm this is the intended design, not an accidental broadening).
acceptance_criteria: Every numbered security invariant checked against the diff
All 3 new routes verified to check Role.PLATFORM_ADMIN before any DB write or read
No catch unreachable on realistic DB failure paths
Cross-tenant data exposure via the status endpoint explicitly assessed
